_comment: Curated map of breach entity_name (normalized lowercase) to the entity's primary public domain, for VirusTotal domain-reputation enrichment. Extend as entities are curated; entries without a warmed ingest read simply render nothing. Domains are warmed portfolio-wide by TrueAPI's virustotal feed (workers/trueapi-ingest/src/virustotal-domains.json) — add new domains there too.
